body:
Hello,
I'm Sajjad Pourali from CERT of Ferdowsi University of Mashhad (cert.um.ac.ir) . 
Our team translated ASVS 2.0 in 2014, and now we translate 3.1 draft version to Persian.
We are ready to remove 3.1 version's additionals for releasing 3.0.1.
This translation is ordered by CERT of Iran (certcc.ir) and we should add their logo to the first or second page of translation document. I know there is no problem with adding this logo (in the current license), but I decide to ask!
If there is no problem, I will submit Persian translation.
title: Persian Translation
